# LegatorOCR v0.2.0-pre.12 (pre-release)

Changes since pre.11. Command-line; the window is unchanged.

**Native OCR (the main change)**
- New model, fine-tuned on real scanned lines of one magazine (40 pages of one issue, labelled with that issue's ABBYY text layer), plus fixes in line finding: two columns above a picture, tall text blocks bridged by noise (whole paragraphs were skipped), garbage lines from ornaments, light text on a mid-dark page.
- Measured on 12 pages of the same magazine that were **not** used for training, against ABBYY's text layer (`pdftotext -raw`, not hand-verified), character error rate: native **3.6 %** on all 12 pages (before: 6.9 %), **2.8 %** on the 8 single-column pages (before: 5.7 %); Tesseract on the same pages 7.8 % and 4.5 %. Without counting spaces: native 2.6 % / 1.7 %, Tesseract 6.3 % / 3.3 %.
- **Not shown**: other typefaces, other scanners, other languages. Training and test pages are the same magazine. On synthetic pages in 8 languages the error rate did not change (0.06-0.07 %). Still weak: letter-spaced display titles between dither bars.
- An earlier yardstick (plain `pdftotext`) put spaces inside words and made every engine look worse; ROADMAP 4.11 explains it.

**Checks and DjVu**
- `--verify-document` also finds double-compressed JPEG pages (a comb in the DCT histogram): 41 of 54 re-saved test pages found, 0 of 24 untouched pages flagged. A hint, not a verdict.
- `--djvu-thumbnails` (with `--djvu`) adds a 128 px preview per page (+3.8 % size for colour, +12.5 % for black and white), off by default.
- `--doubtful-words FILE.tsv` (with `--ocr`, `--doubtful-conf`) lists words whose confidence is low or that are not in the word list; precision about 36 % at confidence < 85.

**Tested and not shipped**: more fine-tuning on synthetic lines only (no gain on real pages), spaces inserted from the image gaps (worse), several page-quality estimators (ROADMAP 4.6, 4.8-4.10).

Not solved: no hand-verified reference text; no real stamped scans; Windows/macOS builds are CI-only; package recipes unsubmitted; FADGI tables and a public TSA contract are open.
